name: Broccoli and Smoked Sausage Cream Cheese Casserole
why: Creamy smoked-sausage-and-broccoli bake bound with a cream-cheese/mayo/cheddar sauce - a richer, casserole-form counterpart to the sheet-pan version (near-duplicate of that candidate; selector should keep only one). PUBLISHED 533 cal / 8g carb / 20g protein per serving clears the band comfortably on carbs and calories, though protein (20g) is below the catalog's 25g ideal. Structurally low-carb, batch-friendly casserole, scales to 14. Cream cheese and mayonnaise may lack board homes - flagged.
